
# Maven Decoratives

> Maven Decoratives is an India-based design-led decorative lighting development and sourcing studio. It develops bespoke decorative lighting for hospitality, commercial and residential projects, coordinating design intent, materials, technical development, specialist manufacturing, approvals and delivery.

Maven works from reference images, sketches, architectural drawings, lighting schedules and BOQs. Its focus includes bespoke chandeliers, pendants, wall sconces, lamps and feature lighting.

Maven coordinates with specialist manufacturing partners. It is a project-development and sourcing studio, not a factory or manufacturer claiming to produce every component in-house.

For project enquiries, share a reference, drawing, BOQ or project requirement through the website contact form, WhatsApp or email.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://mavendecoratives.com/): Overview of Maven Decoratives, its approach, lighting categories, materials and project enquiry process.
- [The Maven Approach](https://mavendecoratives.com/#approach): How design intent is translated into a developed decorative lighting fixture, including technical coordination and manufacturing.
- [Fixture Development Record](https://mavendecoratives.com/#development-record): Illustrative documentation of fixture development, including design interpretation, dimensions, construction, materials, weight, specifications, risks and handover.
- [Lighting Categories](https://mavendecoratives.com/#lighting): Bespoke chandeliers, pendants, wall sconces, lamps and feature lighting.
- [Materials and Finishes](https://mavendecoratives.com/#materials): Metals, crystal, glass, fabric, mixed materials and decorative finishes.
- [Technical Considerations](https://mavendecoratives.com/#technical): Design, construction, material, installation and manufacturing considerations for decorative lighting.
- [Hall of Fame](https://mavendecoratives.com/#hall-of-fame): Designers, ateliers and historical design references informing Maven's design thinking. These are independent references, not affiliations or endorsements.

## Maven Studio

- [Maven Studio](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio): Technical and design articles about bespoke decorative lighting, materials, manufacturing, engineering and finish development.

## Materials, Metals and Surface Engineering

- [Brass, Bronze and Copper: Understanding the Metals Behind Decorative Lighting](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/brass-bronze-copper-decorative-lighting): Material selection, metal composition, manufacturing considerations, finishes, ageing and the use of copper alloys in decorative lighting.
- [Brass vs Kansa: Composition, Finishes and Material Selection for Interior Design](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/brass-vs-kansa-interior-design): Comparison of brass and kansa, their composition, characteristics, finishes and suitability for interior applications.
- [Why Brass and Bronze Change Colour: The Science of Patina, Corrosion and Surface Protection](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/why-brass-bronze-change-colour): Natural oxidation, tarnishing, chemical patination, dezincification, fingerprints, humidity, sulphur compounds, chlorides, protective coatings, PVD, surface preparation, manufacturing controls and performance testing.
- [Before You Polish That Brass: A Hotel Engineer's Guide to Tarnish, Patina and Corrosion](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/before-you-polish-brass): Practical identification, cleaning, maintenance and restoration considerations for aged brass lamps, chandeliers and decorative metalwork.
- [PVD vs Electroplating vs Lacquer: Choosing a Finish for Decorative Metalwork](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/pvd-vs-electroplating-vs-lacquer): Comparison of decorative metal finishing systems, their processes, properties, limitations and selection considerations.
- [Inside a Metal Foundry: How Casting Works, from Pattern to Finished Component](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/metal-casting-process-foundry): Metal casting workflow, patterns, moulds, pouring, finishing and the production of decorative metal components.

## Design Development and Manufacturing

- [From Reference Image to Manufacturable Object: A Technical Workflow for Bespoke Lighting](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/from-reference-image-to-manufacturable-object): How a visual reference is interpreted, developed and coordinated into a manufacturable decorative lighting fixture.
- [How to Calculate Chandelier Weight: Rod Count, Spacing, Structure and Ceiling Loads](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/how-to-calculate-chandelier-weight): Estimating fixture weight from components and construction, suspension considerations, load distribution and structural coordination.
- [Heavy Chandelier Installation: Structural Support, Suspension Systems and Architectural Coordination](https://mavendecoratives.com/studio/heavy-chandelier-installation): Structural support, load paths, suspension systems, fixing points, ceiling coordination, installation planning and maintenance access.

## Important Context

Maven Studio articles provide technical and design information for architects, interior designers, consultants, procurement teams, contractors and manufacturers.

Technical recommendations depend on the actual fixture, materials, manufacturing methods, installation conditions and applicable project requirements. Project-specific structural and electrical decisions should be verified by appropriately qualified professionals.

Design references and historical designers mentioned on the website are included for educational and inspiration purposes. No affiliation, endorsement or authorship is implied.
